en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing the skyline of Bautzen with distinctive medieval towers and buildings. Two prominent towers are visible, one cylindrical and the other more conical with a spire, likely part of a church. The text at the top identifies the structures as Michaeliskirche (St. Michael's Church) and the Alte Wasserkunst (Old Waterworks), both set amid old town architecture.
